title: More Than Realistic
description: Mods adds realistic features in you minecraft
body:
![More than realistic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21e1407e05837224680a35d54b8d4fbca30e7d44.png)

A modification that introduces minor realistic adjustments to mob behavior, weather phenomena, and block interactions. All features can be toggled or customized via the in-game configuration menu accessible from the pause screen.

## Animals & NPCs

* **Herd Panic** - Attacking an animal causes all nearby individuals of the same species within a specific configurable radius to panic.
* **Horse Panic** - Nearby lightning strikes cause horses to run. If ridden, there is a configurable percentage chance that the rider will be dismounted.
* **Fox Stealing** - If the player's hunger bar drops below 3 units and they hold food in their hand, nearby wild foxes can steal one item of food.
* **Golem Panic** - Attacking an Iron Golem causes all villagers within the local village radius to flee into nearby houses.

## World & Weather

* **Snow Melting** - Snow layers and snow blocks gradually melt when placed within a specific configurable radius of heat sources, including lava, fire, active furnaces, and lit campfires.
* **Lightning Glass** - Lightning striking sand or red sand blocks has a chance to transform the blocks at the epicenter into glass.
* **Lightning Rod Break** - Introduces a 0.001% chance for a lightning rod to break and disappear upon receiving a lightning strike.

## Blocks & Mechanics

* **Stonecutter Damage** - Standing on top of an active stonecutter inflicts minor continuous physical damage to the entity.
* **Wet Campfires** - Extinguished campfires exposed to direct rain transfer into a "wet" state, making them significantly harder to relight with flint and steel.
* **Campfire Struggle** - Burning campfires exposed to direct rain do not extinguish immediately; they hiss and emit sparks for several seconds before completely going out.
* **Trapdoor Rain** - Open trapdoors do not obstruct weather, allowing rain to pass through and extinguish fires or players positioned directly beneath them.
